# Multi-Cloud Strategy Blueprint

This document articulates the strategic direction and architectural principles for extending the client's existing Azure foundation with a federated multi-cloud model. The primary goal is to validate this proposed model, ensuring it effectively meets the client's evolving demands for specialized AI/ML and data-intensive workloads. Success will be measured by stakeholder alignment on the strategic direction and the architectural principles outlined herein, paving the way for robust solutions and a future-proof cloud strategy.

## 1. Strategic Rationale for Federated Multi-Cloud Adoption

The strategic decision to adopt a federated multi-cloud model is a direct response to the limitations identified within a single-hyperscaler approach, particularly concerning the specialized requirements of advanced AI/ML and data-intensive workloads.
